products.name: Abhayarishtam
products.dosage: 15 ml to 30 ml twice daily after meals with equal quantity of warm water.
products.indications: Hemorrhoids (Piles), chronic constipation, flatulence, abdominal bloating, spleen disorders.
products.description: Abhayarishtam is a premier classical fermented digestive elixir formulated with Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Vidanga, and Dhataki. It stimulates Agni (digestive fire) and softens bowel movement naturally.

products.name: Amritarishtam
products.dosage: 15 ml to 25 ml twice daily diluted with equal water after food.
products.indications: Chronic low-grade fevers, post-viral convalescence, splenomegaly, hepatomegaly, burning sensation.
products.description: Formulated around Guduchi (Tinospora cordifolia), the divine nectar herb. It purifies blood, detoxifies hepatic channels, and restores vitality after infectious debility.

products.name: Ashokarishtam
products.dosage: 15 ml to 30 ml twice daily after food with water.
products.indications: Menorrhagia, metrorrhagia, dysmenorrhea, pelvic pain, female endocrine tonic.
products.description: The quintessential uterine tonic in classical Ayurveda. Bark of Saraca asoca combined with Haritaki and Musta stabilizes uterine microvasculature and hormones.

products.name: Balarishtam
products.dosage: 15 ml to 25 ml after food twice daily.
products.indications: Hemiplegia, paraplegia, facial palsy, sciatica, muscular dystrophy, arthritis.
products.description: Bala (Sida cordifolia) and Ashwagandha in fermented harmony. Powerful rejuvenating tonic for neuromuscular regeneration and Vata vyadhi relief.

products.name: Draksharishtam
products.dosage: 15 ml to 30 ml twice daily after meals with water.
products.indications: Chronic cough, general weakness, respiratory fatigue, anemia, loss of appetite.
products.description: Prepared from high-grade dried raisins (Draksha) and fragrant spices. Restores hemoglobin levels, lubricates the respiratory tract, and enhances stamina.

products.name: Dashamoolarishtam
products.dosage: 15 ml to 30 ml after meals with equal quantity water.
products.indications: Post-natal rejuvenation, fatigue, Vata disorders, cough, digestive weakness.
products.description: Renowned comprehensive tonic made from 10 sacred roots (Dashamoola) and over 50 synergistic botanical botanicals. Strengthens the postpartum mother and general physical vitality.

products.name: Punarnavarishtam
products.dosage: 15 ml to 25 ml twice daily after meals with equal water.
products.indications: Edema, ascites, renal dysfunction, splenomegaly, gouty arthritis, liver sluggishness.
products.description: Punarnava literally means 'that which renews'. Renowned diuretic and nephro-protective formulation that flushes cellular fluids and metabolic toxins.

products.name: Saraswatarishtam
products.dosage: 10 ml to 20 ml with equal water twice daily after food.
products.indications: Memory loss, mental fatigue, anxiety, speech impairment, intellectual clarity.
products.description: Supreme Medhya Rasayana (nootropic brain tonic) infused with Brahmi, Gold (Swarna Bhasma in classical gold grade), Shatavari, and Vidanga.

products.name: Kanakasavam
products.dosage: 10 ml to 20 ml with warm water twice daily.
products.indications: Bronchial asthma, chronic bronchitis, spasmodic cough, chest congestion.
products.description: Potent bronchodilator formulation formulated with purified Kanaka (Datura metel), Vasa (Adhatoda vasica), and Yashtimadhu for clearing respiratory passages.

products.name: Aravindasavam
products.dosage: 5 ml to 15 ml for children, diluted with equal water twice daily.
products.indications: Pediatric growth tonic, emaciation, poor appetite, digestive weakness in infants and children.
products.description: Formulated with sacred Lotus (Aravinda / Nelumbo nucifera) and cooling herbs. Promotes healthy pediatric development, immunity, and digestive strength.

products.name: Maharasnadi Kashayam
products.dosage: 15 ml concentrated decoction diluted in 45 ml boiled warm water, twice daily before food.
products.indications: Osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, cervical & lumbar spondylosis, hemiplegia, sciatica.
products.description: The gold-standard classical decoction for pacifying aggravated Vata in joints and musculoskeletal tissues. Formulated with Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata) and Erandamoola.

products.name: Dhanwantharam Tailam
products.dosage: Apply warm oil over the body in smooth strokes 30 mins before bathing; or as advised by physician.
products.indications: Prenatal and postnatal Abhyanga, hemiplegia, osteoarthritis, general body ache, tissue emaciation.
products.description: Revered oil named after Lord Dhanwanthari. Prepared through 28 distinct clinical boilings of Bala root decoction, milk, and 40 rare Himalayan and Western Ghats herbs.
